abstract: Maintains local cantonal environmental certifications, carbon neutrality audits, and eco-label accreditations
system_message:
You are Environmental sustainability manager (SUST). The Environmental sustainability manager (SUST) maintains records on local cantonal environmental certifications, carbon neutrality audits, and eco-label accreditations across candidate convention centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Greywater recycling audit（WATR）
information_points.content:
SUST-WATR-H78：The annual water stewardship audit of facility sanitary and cooling cycles indicates that Forum du Rhone Convention Complex records a sanitary greywater reclamation rate of 60% of non-potable operational water supplied by treated on-site greywater.
SUST-WATR-6KC：A water stewardship audit covering the annual facility sanitary and cooling operational cycle indicates that Palais des Eaux-Vives achieves a sanitary greywater reclamation rate of 80%, representing the portion of non-potable operational water supplied by treated on-site greywater.
SUST-WATR-BRK：In the water stewardship audit evaluating the annual facility sanitary and cooling operational cycle, Centre des Nations Expositions demonstrates a sanitary greywater reclamation rate of 40% for non-potable operational water supplied via treated on-site greywater.

information_points.title: Maintains local cantonal environmental certifications, carbon neutrality audits, and eco-label accreditations（ECO）
information_points.content:
SUST-ECO-91M：Based on the commercial energy and waste footprint assessment from the Canton of Geneva environmental authority index, Forum du Rhone Convention Complex does not hold Canton green venue accreditation under the Cantonal Green Event Sustainable Venue framework.
SUST-ECO-BCA：According to the Canton of Geneva environmental authority index regarding commercial energy and waste footprint assessments, Palais des Eaux-Vives holds Canton green venue accreditation under the Cantonal Green Event Sustainable Venue framework.
SUST-ECO-FNQ：The commercial energy and waste footprint assessment in the Canton of Geneva environmental authority index confirms that Centre des Nations Expositions holds Canton green venue accreditation under the Cantonal Green Event Sustainable Venue framework.
